c.fx-aether: Adds air to the top of a sound with two amounts, mid air and high air, plus an exciter. An arc meter shows the output peak.
c.fx-apex-limiter: Mastering limiter with look-ahead, a true-peak ceiling, selectable styles, an optional levelling stage, oversampling, dither and a loudness meter, shown over a scrolling level display.
c.fx-atrium: Room and chamber reverb with separate early and late sections, bass and high decay multipliers, and twelve room types.
c.fx-audio-effect-rack: Ableton Live-style rack in a mixer slot. Parallel chains of effects share the input and are summed, with chain-select zones, chain volume and pan, and 16 macros.
c.fx-auto-pan: Moves a sound between left and right from a tempo-synced LFO or a step pattern. It can also output only a control signal.
c.fx-chorus: Simple chorus with rate, depth, feedback and mix, and a display of the two modulation waves for the left and right channels.
c.fx-compressor: Compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, release, make-up gain and mix. It has a Classic voicing with a clean or FET law, a Vintage voicing and a switchable limiter.
c.fx-control-surface: A panel you build from knobs, sliders, buttons, check boxes and XY pads. Each control is an output that other parameters can be linked to.
c.fx-crest-compressor: Style compressor with eleven styles, knee, range, look-ahead, a three-band side-chain EQ, character, oversampling and a live gain-reduction graph.
c.fx-crossover: A high-pass and a low-pass filter in one effect, each with its own cutoff and slope in decibels per octave, and a response display.
c.fx-delay: Simple echo with time, feedback, damping, mix and a ping-pong switch. Time can follow the song tempo, and the display shows the repeats.
c.fx-distortion: Drive-based distortion with tone, mix and output level, and a graph of the input to output curve.
c.fx-distructor: Chain of up to four modules, distortion, filter, chorus or amp and cabinet, each with in, mix and out controls, followed by a soft clipper.
c.fx-echoform: Multi-mode echo with tape, bucket brigade, analog, digital, shifter, pitch and reverse characters, tempo sync, wow and flutter, and feedback past 100 percent.
c.fx-edison: Audio editor in a mixer slot, as in FL Studio: it records the slot's input, passes it on and can play its audio back in time with the song. Its window is the LYNX SHARE audio editor.
c.fx-effector: Twelve effect types on one XY pad, each with two parameters, an LFO that follows the song tempo, and input and output gain.
c.fx-ember-saturator: Saturator with tube, tape, transistor and fuzz styles, tone tilt, auto gain and oversampling, which can split the signal into up to four bands with their own style and drive.
c.fx-emphasis: Limiter-style dynamics effect with an emphasis amount, ceiling, envelope and hardness controls, true peak and mid/side modes, oversampling and a level-matching option.
c.fx-emphasizer: Effect with input gain, an emphasis amount, output level, soft clipping and level matching, and a 2 ms look-ahead that is reported for delay compensation.
c.fx-epoch-verb: Reverb with 22 algorithms covering halls, plates, rooms, chorused and random spaces and gated tails, in three colours of converter character.
c.fx-eq: Simple three-band equaliser with low and high bands, a mid band with adjustable frequency, an output level and a live curve display.
c.fx-equo: Graphic equaliser with 31 third-octave bands and eight banks, with band shift, mix and morph, per-band volume, pan and send.
c.fx-facet-eq: Eight-band equaliser with bells, shelves, notches and cuts up to 96 dB per octave, a spectrum display, dynamic bands and tone matching against another track.
c.fx-filter: State-variable filter with low-pass, high-pass and band-pass modes at 12 dB per octave, with cutoff, resonance, mix and a live response curve.
c.fx-foil-plate: Bright plate reverb that speaks at once, with a frequency-dependent decay, twelve plate types, low and high EQ shelves and modulation.
c.fx-formula-controller: Controller that outputs a value from 0 to 1 calculated by a formula of three knobs and the song position, to link to any parameter.
c.fx-frequency-shifter: Moves every frequency of the signal by a fixed amount of hertz in shifter, high quality shifter or ring modulator mode, with feedback and stereo phase controls.
c.fx-frequency-shifter-2: Simple frequency shifter that moves all frequencies up or down by a number of hertz, with mix and stereo controls and a spectrum display.
c.fx-frequency-splitter: Splits the signal into two or three frequency bands with crossover slopes from 6 to 96 dB per octave and sends each band to its own insert.
c.fx-fret-channel: Channel strip for guitar and bass with phase correction, a three-band equaliser with filters, a compressor and a drive section with guitar and bass amp models.
c.fx-fruity-7-band-eq: Seven fixed-frequency bands with one gain fader each: a low shelf, five peaking bands and a high shelf, for quick tone shaping on a mixer insert.
c.fx-fruity-balance: A simple stereo balance control with a volume knob and level meters, for shifting a signal between left and right or trimming its level.
c.fx-fruity-bass-boost: Adds low frequencies with a resonant low-pass whose output is mixed back into the dry signal. Two controls: frequency and amount.
c.fx-fruity-big-clock: A silent display that shows the song position in large digits. It does not process audio and offers three time formats.
c.fx-fruity-blood-overdrive: An overdrive with a pre filter, a colour control, a large pre-amp knob with an x100 switch, and a post filter and gain.
c.fx-fruity-center: Removes DC offset with a two-pole high-pass filter. A single On and Off switch, for cleaning a signal before further processing.
c.fx-fruity-chorus: A chorus with three LFOs, each with its own frequency and waveform, plus stereo spread and a crossover that decides which part is chorused.
c.fx-fruity-compressor: A compressor with threshold, ratio, gain, attack, release and a hard or soft type, and support for a sidechain input.
c.fx-fruity-convolver: A convolution effect that applies an impulse response to the signal, with dry and wet levels, stereo separation, delay, stretch and an EQ curve.
c.fx-fruity-delay-2: A feedback delay with input pan and volume, dry level, time and stereo offset, plus a feedback section with three modes and a cutoff.
c.fx-fruity-delay-3: A stereo delay with tempo sync, modulation, diffusion, a filtered feedback path and feedback distortion with sample rate and bit reduction.
c.fx-fruity-delay-bank: A bank of up to eight delay lines with per-line input, filter, feedback, grain and output sections, plus global dry, wet, input and feedback levels.
c.fx-fruity-delay: The original simple delay: a sixteenth-note delay line with input, feedback and cutoff, a tempo setting, a step count and three stereo modes.
c.fx-fruity-fast-dist: A quick distortion with pre-amp, threshold, mix and post gain, two types (A and B) and a transfer curve display.
c.fx-fruity-fast-lp: A resonant low-pass filter with just two controls, cutoff and resonance. Cheap to run and handy for darkening a track or sweeping a filter.
c.fx-fruity-filter: A state-variable filter with separate low-pass, band-pass and high-pass levels that you can mix freely, plus resonance and an optional second pass.
c.fx-fruity-flanger: A tape-style flanger with an LFO-swept delay line, damped feedback, phase offset between the sides and separate dry and wet levels.
c.fx-fruity-flangus: A multi-voice flanger and chorus hybrid with adjustable voice order, depth, speed and delay, plus spread and cross controls for the stereo image.
c.fx-fruity-free-filter: A single filter with seven types: low pass, band pass, high pass, notch, low shelf, peaking and high shelf. Frequency, Q and gain are adjustable.
c.fx-fruity-html-notebook: A notepad for the project that shows a page from a local HTML file or a web address. The sound passes through unchanged.
c.fx-fruity-limiter: A limiter, compressor and noise gate in one effect, with gain, saturation, ceiling, envelope curves and a sidechain-capable compression section.
c.fx-fruity-love-philter: A multi-unit filter and shaper with eight chainable units, envelopes, LFOs and an envelope follower for animated filtering.
c.fx-fruity-multiband-compressor: A three-band compressor with adjustable crossovers, separate threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee and gain per band, and an optional linear-phase mode.
c.fx-fruity-mute-2: A mute switch for a mixer insert slot that silences the left side, the right side or both. Useful as an automatable on and off for a signal.
c.fx-fruity-panomatic: A pan and volume control with a built-in LFO that can modulate either one, for auto-panning and tremolo-style movement.
c.fx-fruity-phase-inverter: Flips the polarity of the signal. In its default state only the right side is inverted.
c.fx-fruity-phaser: A phaser with a variable number of stages, sweep range and speed, stereo phase offset, feedback and a dry and wet mix.
c.fx-fruity-scratcher: A turntable that plays a loaded sample on a platter you can spin, hold and scratch. Its sound is added to the signal passing through.
c.fx-fruity-send: Sends the signal at its place in an effect chain to another mixer insert, with its own volume, pan and dry level.
c.fx-fruity-soft-clipper: Soft clipper with a threshold and a post gain, showing its transfer curve. Rounds off peaks that pass the threshold.
c.fx-fruity-waveshaper: Draws a transfer curve that reshapes every sample, with pre amp, mix and post gain. Used for distortion, folding and custom saturation.
c.fx-gemini-doubler: Two-voice vocal doubler. Each voice has its own delay, detune, pitch drift, pan, gain and feedback, plus an octave-down switch and voice shelves.
c.fx-glow-leveler: Optical leveler built on an electro-optical cell model, with peak reduction, gain, compress or limit mode, a VU meter and mix control.
c.fx-gross-beat: Time and volume slicing effect with 36 time and 36 volume slots for stutters, gates, tape stops and reverses.
c.fx-halo: Shimmer reverb with a pitch shifter of plus or minus 12 semitones inside the decay, one or two voices, and tone and modulation controls.
c.fx-hardcore: Guitar pedalboard of five boxes holding 11 pedal types, plus cabinet convolution and an 8-band EQ. Needs files from your own FL Studio installation.
c.fx-hardware-insert: Sends audio out of an output on your audio device to outboard gear and brings the return back in, with level, invert and dry/wet controls.
c.fx-horizon: Echo into or after a reverb. Tape, analog, digital, reverse and octave echoes feed eight reverb modes, with modulation and EQ.
c.fx-hush-de-esser: Split-band or wideband de-esser with band or high-pass detection, a listen mode and 2 ms lookahead, shown over a live waveform.
c.fx-hyper-chorus: Dense chorus with two four-voice cores, movement panning, filters and a high-pass cross-fade, built from FL Studio's saved controls.
c.fx-kiln-channel: Single console channel strip with six console models, drive, input and output trims, noise reduction and a group bypass shared across channels.
c.fx-lattice-mod: Multitap modulated delay with 1 to 16 taps, detune and vibrato, rotating stereo feedback, diffusion and drive, in six tabbed pages.
c.fx-limiter: Simple output limiter with a gain knob, a ceiling and a release time. A transfer display shows how the level is being shaped.
c.fx-lo-fi: Sample rate and bit depth reducer with a dry and wet mix. Use it for crunchy, grainy or retro digital sounds.
c.fx-low-lifter: Generates harmonics of the low end of a sound and shows them in a display. It has a look-ahead limiter, a diffuser and a low cut.
c.fx-luxeverb: Large reverb with decay, size, diffusion, a feedback or feedforward pitch shifter, an output peak filter and a side-chain controlled envelope.
c.fx-lynx-tune: Real-time vocal pitch corrector with key and scale selection, adjustable retune speed, formant control, a breathiness knob and MIDI target notes.
c.fx-maximus: Three-band compressor, limiter and saturator for mastering, with a master section, adjustable crossovers and a low cut.
c.fx-multiband-delay: Splits the sound into 16 bands, each with its own delay, volume and pan, with eight switchable banks and a morph control.
c.fx-nebula: Delay and reverb networks with free or tempo-synced delay time, feedback, density, warp and 22 network shapes to choose from.
c.fx-newtime: Time editor for a sample using warp markers. In a song it passes audio through, and plays the warped sample when set to follow the host.
c.fx-newtone: Pitch editor for a sung or played sample. It finds the notes so you can move, cut and reshape them, and plays the edit with the song.
c.fx-orbit: Modulation machine with barber-pole and through-zero flangers, choruses, a doubler, an ensemble and a symphonic mode, controlled by five knobs.
c.fx-parametric-eq: Seven-band parametric equaliser with a draggable frequency response and a linear-phase mode, used for tone shaping on any insert.
c.fx-patcher: Node graph that holds plugins and cables inside one insert, with side-chain, extra outputs and a control surface you can build.
c.fx-peak-controller: Follows the level of the audio and an LFO and turns them into control values that can move other plugin parameters.
c.fx-pitch-correction: Real-time pitch corrector for a single voice or line. Notes you leave lit on the keyboard strip pull the sung pitch towards them, with a speed control.
c.fx-pitch-shift: Simple pitch shifter with semitone and cent controls, a grain size and a dry and wet mix. Used to transpose a track or add a detuned copy.
c.fx-pitch-shifter: Pitch and formant shifter with voice and music modes, a delay with feedback and pitch analysis settings. It runs the engines of the FL Studio original.
c.fx-pocket-autoduck: Ducks the volume on every beat of the song, with depth, attack, hold, length, shift and six recovery shapes. No sidechain input is needed. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Autoduck.
c.fx-pocket-chorus: Chorus with two modulated voices, rate, depth, stereo spread and mix. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Chorus.
c.fx-pocket-comb-filter: Comb filter with feedback that is tuned by hand, to the lowest held key, or to the pitch it detects in the input. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Comb Filter.
c.fx-pocket-compressor: Peak compressor with threshold, ratio up to infinity, attack, hold, release, auto gain, an output level and a detector input gain. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Compressor.
c.fx-pocket-distortion: Distortion with four curves, drive, bias, a left and right drive balance, a sample-and-hold crusher and an output gain. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Distortion.
c.fx-pocket-eq: Four-band equalizer with a low shelf, peak or high shelf per band, a bandwidth in octaves and a choice of channel per band. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Equalizer.
c.fx-pocket-filter: Low-pass, band-pass or high-pass filter with a frequency, a Q and a slope of 24, 48 or 96 dB per octave. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Filter.
c.fx-pocket-flanger: Flanger built on a short tape loop of up to 5 ms, with an LFO, feedback, a stereo phase offset and polarity switches for feedback and wet. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Flanger.
c.fx-pocket-gate: Noise gate with threshold, asymmetry, attack, hold and release with curve controls, and a mix control that can invert the gate. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Gate.
c.fx-pocket-graphic-eq: Eight-band graphic equalizer from 80 Hz to 12 kHz, one octave per band. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Graphic EQ.
c.fx-pocket-leveller: Gain and pan trim with a level meter and a dB scale. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Leveller.
c.fx-pocket-limiter-classic: Peak limiter with threshold, release time and output gain and no look-ahead. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Limiter (legacy).
c.fx-pocket-limiter: Look-ahead peak limiter with input gain, threshold, release and output gain, and a trace of the gain reduction. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Limiter.
c.fx-pocket-multiband-compressor: Three-band compressor with two crossovers, and per band an input gain, threshold, ratio, attack, release, output gain, On, Bypass or Mute, and a stereo width. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Multiband Compressor.
c.fx-pocket-multifx: Eight effects on one X/Y pad: delay, reverb, low-pass and high-pass filter, flanger, phaser, panner and a vowel filter, with a tempo-locked LFO. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's MultiFX.
c.fx-pocket-phaser: Six-stage phaser with feedback, a centre frequency, a tempo-synced or free LFO with three shapes, and a stereo phase offset. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Phaser.
c.fx-pocket-reverb: Plate reverb with one Mix knob that blends dry and wet, decay, damping, room size, predelay, width, low and high cuts, early reflections, modulation and a pan for the reverb. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Reverb.
c.fx-pocket-reverb-2: Plate reverb with size, decay, damping, low and high cuts, dry, early reflection and wet levels, a predelay of up to 1000 ms that can follow the tempo, a side input, separation and a wet pan. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Reverb 2.
c.fx-pocket-reverb-classic: Plate reverb with decay, room size, predelay, damping, low and high cuts, a bass multiplier, modulation, and input, early reflection, dry and wet levels in dB with a mute switch each. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Reverb (legacy).
c.fx-pocket-spacer: Stereo tool with a left/right delay, pan, separation, a mid/side delay, polarity switches for each pair and three stereo modes. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Spacer.
c.fx-pocket-spreader: Stereo widener that delays a side signal and adds it back, with width, separation, a low frequency bypass and a mono bass amount. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Spreader.
c.fx-pocket-stereoizer: Makes a stereo image from the mono sum with a filtered short delay, plus a left/right delay and a pan. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Stereoizer.
c.fx-pocket-tape-delay: Tape-style delay with time, feedback, a left and right time offset and mix. Changing the time bends the pitch of the echoes. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Tape Delay.
c.fx-pocket-tape-stop: Slows the sound down to a stop like a tape machine and speeds it up again, with free or tempo-synced stop and start times, a Play switch and a curve for the speed. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Tape Stop.
c.fx-pocket-trance-delay: Tempo-synced delay with five beat lengths, Stereo, Ping-Pong and Mirror modes, feedback, a low-pass or high-pass filter in the loop and a mix control. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Trance Delay.
c.fx-pocket-tremolo: Tremolo and auto-pan with a free or tempo-synced rate, minimum and maximum gain, a stereo offset and four controls for the wave shape. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Tremolo.
c.fx-pocket-waveshaper: Waveshaping distortion with seven curves, X and Y shape controls, an LFO, input filters, a three-band tone section, auto-gain and mix. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Waveshaper.
c.fx-pocket-wow-flutter: Tape-style pitch wobble from a modulated delay: a slow wow, a fast flutter and a random change of the wow rate, free or tempo synced. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's Wow & Flutter.
c.fx-prism-multiband: Four-band dynamics processor. Each band can compress or expand, downward or upward, with its own attack, release, knee and level, drawn over a spectrum.
c.fx-quell-denoiser: One-knob noise suppressor with six bands, each with a downward expander that follows the Amount control. Listen plays back what is being removed.
c.fx-reeverb-2: Algorithmic reverb with room size, diffusion, decay, damping, early reflections and modulation. It runs the engine of the FL Studio original.
c.fx-reeverb: Compact reverb with low and high cut, pre-delay, room size, diffusion, colour, decay and damping. It runs the engine of the FL Studio original.
c.fx-reverb: LYNX SHARE's own reverb with room size, damping, width, pre-delay, low and high cut, and separate dry and wet levels, plus a decay curve display.
c.fx-rhythmic-envelope: Gain envelope drawn as up to twelve points over a looped length in beats and locked to the song. It gives rhythmic pumping or gating.
c.fx-ridge-strip: Console-style channel strip with high and low pass filters, a four-band equaliser with two curve families, a compressor and a gate or expander.
c.fx-sentry-gate: Gate and expander with Classic, Clean, Vocal, Guitar and Upward styles, plus hold, knee, look-ahead and side-chain filters, drawn over a level display.
c.fx-shell-channel: Drum channel strip with a gate, a transient shaper, low and high frequency enhancers and a listen-mic compressor, in an order you can rearrange.
c.fx-spiral-echo: Frequency-shifting echo. Every repeat moves by the shift amount, in opposite directions on the left and right in stereo, with filters in the feedback loop.
c.fx-spreader: Stereo widener with spread and separation controls, a low frequency bypass and a mono switch, with a picture of the stereo image.
c.fx-squeeze: Coarsens the signal in steps, with an optional filter, a dry/wet mix and an output volume. Used for bit-crush style grit.
c.fx-stereo-enhancer: Pan, volume, stereo separation and phase offset in one small effect, with an option to invert. Used to widen or narrow a stereo signal.
c.fx-stereo-shaper: A stereo matrix that sets how much of each input side reaches left and right, with delay and phase between the channels.
c.fx-strike-shaper: Level-independent transient designer. Attack and Sustain knobs shape hits and tails without a threshold, with output gain, parallel mix, a soft-clip guard and a detector high-pass.
c.fx-transient-processor: Shapes the attack and release of a sound with separate shape controls, a gain, a drive and a frequency split.
c.fx-transmitter: Splits a sound into transient and sustain parts and treats each with its own level, tilt and saturation, diffusion, bounce or delay.
c.fx-transporter: Detects transients and loops short slices of the input in two loops, with reverse and octave jumps, spread and auto-pan.
c.fx-tuner: Shows the note and the tuning of the incoming audio, in a basic view or as a dial, with an adjustable reference pitch.
c.fx-utility: Gain, balance and a four-way channel matrix for the left and right inputs. Used for simple level and channel fixes.
c.fx-vintage-chorus: A two-delay chorus with an LFO, feedback, high-pass filter on the wet signal, hiss and a noise gate.
c.fx-vintage-phaser: A phaser with a frequency range, feedback, LFO and tempo sync, plus a built-in delay section and input colouring.
c.fx-visualizer: Draws moving graphics from the audio in layers, with bars, rays, particles and images. It can export video and import FL visualiser presets.
c.fx-vocoder: A band vocoder that imposes the spectrum of a modulator on a carrier, with band count, filter order, formant and envelope controls.
c.fx-vocodex: A vocoder built from the saved state of the FL Studio plugin, with 13 per-band maps, followers, a gate and unison. Parts need an FL Studio installation.
c.fx-voice-shift: Shifts pitch and formant of a voice or instrument, with a link between them, a drive stage, a mix and optional MIDI control.
c.fx-volume-gate: Rhythmic gate with 32 drawable steps that cuts the signal on and off in time with the song, with attack, release and mix controls.
c.fx-wave-candy: Audio display with oscilloscope, spectrum, spectrogram, peak meter and vectorscope modes. It shows the sound passing through and does not change it.
c.fx-x-y-controller: Two-axis pad controller with level, range and tension per axis. Its outputs can be linked to any knob in the project.
c.fx-x-y-z-controller: Three-axis pad controller with level, range, tension and output curve per axis. Its outputs can be linked to any knob in the project.
c.gen-3x-osc: Three-oscillator subtractive synth with several wave shapes per oscillator, detune and phase controls, and an optional high-quality oscillator mode.
c.gen-bassdrum: Bass drum generator with pitch, duration, drive, sub bass and click controls, plus a noise layer that uses a wave file. Needs FL Studio data.
c.gen-beepmap: Image-synthesis generator that turns the columns and rows of a bitmap into sound. Load a picture or paste one and play it with the keyboard.
c.gen-boobass: Bass instrument with a three-band EQ, built on a bass multisample. Needs FL Studio data, otherwise it falls back to a plain saw tone.
c.gen-clap: Built-in synthesised clap drum: a band-passed noise burst with three short snaps and a tail. Part of the default drum rack.
c.gen-dashboard: Control panel that you build from knobs, sliders, buttons, check boxes and XY pads. Each control is an output you can link to any knob.
c.gen-drum-rack: Ableton Live-style drum rack for the Channel Rack: 16 pads in view out of 128, each pad a chain with its own instrument and effects, with choke groups, return chains and sends. Drum Racks in Live sets (.als) open as one Drum Rack.
c.gen-drumaxx: Physical-model drum engine with sixteen pads, each with mallet, membrane, EQ band and velocity sections, plus a master EQ and limiter.
c.gen-drumpad: Physical-model drum with mallet, membrane, low, mid and high resonator sections and velocity routing, for kicks, toms, snares and hand percussion.
c.gen-envelope-controller: Note-triggered controller with envelope, LFO and key, velocity and modulation maps per output. It makes no sound and drives linked knobs.
c.gen-fl-keys: Sampled piano, electric piano and keys instrument with decay, release, overdrive, velocity and tuning controls. Needs FL Studio data.
c.gen-fl-slayer: Six-string guitar generator with play modes, an effects section, four amp types and four cabinets. Plays and imports FL Slayer channels.
c.gen-fpc: Pad drum sampler with 32 pads in two banks. Each pad has velocity layers, volume and pan envelopes, cut groups and its own trigger note.
c.gen-fruit-kick: Small kick drum generator with pitch sweep, amplitude decay, click and distortion knobs. Plays and imports Fruit Kick channels.
c.gen-fruity-dance: Silent channel that shows an animated dancer on screen. Notes choose the dance move, and it can load sprite sheets made for Fruity Dance.
c.gen-fruity-dx10: Two-operator FM synthesizer with an amplitude envelope, two modulator sections and a low-frequency oscillator. Plays and imports Fruity DX10 channels.
c.gen-fruity-granulizer: Granular sampler that plays a sample as a stream of short grains, with grain shape, spacing, pan, depth and speed controls.
c.gen-fruity-slicer: Beat slicer that cuts a loop into slices and plays each slice from its own key. Can dump the beat to the piano roll, and has an envelope page.
c.gen-fruity-video-player: Plays a video file in step with the song position and can show it in its own window, with start, end and delay settings.
c.gen-gms: Subtractive synthesizer with three oscillators, filter, two envelopes, two LFOs, ten effect slots and an output equaliser. Plays and imports GMS channels.
c.gen-gmsynth-flm: FL Studio Mobile's GMSynth module as its own voice engine. A channel gets it when you open an FL Studio Mobile project (.flm). It is not in the plugin picker.
c.gen-harmless: Additive synthesizer with timbre sliders, harmonic mask, filter, unison, phaser, harmonizer, LFO and an effects rack. Plays and imports Harmless channels.
c.gen-harmor: Additive synthesizer with image synthesis, two filters, unison, blur, prism, harmonizer and an effects rack. Plays and imports Harmor channels.
c.gen-hat: Built-in hi-hat generator: a short burst of high-passed noise. Add it as a channel and trigger it from the step sequencer.
c.gen-instrument-rack: Ableton Live-style rack for the Channel Rack. Parallel chains each hold MIDI effects, an instrument and audio effects, with key, velocity and chain-select zones and 16 macros.
c.gen-kepler: Analogue-style synthesizer with one oscillator, sub and noise, high-pass and low-pass filters, envelope, chorus and an arpeggiator. Plays and imports Kepler channels.
c.gen-kepler-exo: Two-oscillator analogue-style synthesizer with cross modulation, two envelopes and LFOs, modulation matrix, arpeggiator and effects. Plays and imports Kepler Exo channels.
c.gen-keyboard-controller: Control generator that turns the last key played into a value you draw per key. It makes no sound and can drive other controls.
c.gen-kick: Built-in kick drum: a sine tone that sweeps down from about 155 Hz to 45 Hz with a short decay. It has no editor window.
c.gen-layer: Makes no sound itself. Every note it receives is passed on to its child channels, so one pattern can play several generators at once.
c.gen-lynx-soundfont: Plays SoundFont 2 and 3 banks and SFZ instruments, with preset search across all your SoundFonts, envelope, filter and built-in reverb and chorus.
c.gen-midi-effect-rack: Ableton Live-style rack of MIDI effect chains on a Channel Rack channel. It makes no sound itself: the notes from its chains play the channels set as its children.
c.gen-midi-out: A silent channel that sends its notes and controller values as MIDI to the plugins listening on its port, and carries 72 controller knobs.
c.gen-minisynth: Synth engine with table oscillators and noise, a 4-pole filter, two envelopes, an LFO and distortion, delay, phaser and chorus effects, rebuilt from FL Studio's MiniSynth.
c.gen-morphine: Additive synthesizer engine that morphs between waveforms, with a noise generator, equaliser and chorus, delay and reverb effects.
c.gen-ogun: Additive synthesizer engine with spectral timbre controls, unison, filter, three-band equaliser and chorus, delay and reverb effects.
c.gen-patcher: A node graph of instruments, effects and VST3 or CLAP plugins joined by audio, note and control cables, used as a Channel Rack generator.
c.gen-plucked: Plucked string synthesizer using a Karplus-Strong delay line, with decay and colour knobs plus normalise, gate and widen switches.
c.gen-pocket-supersaw: Virtual analog synth with up to 12 detuned saws per voice, a sub oscillator, a 4-pole low-pass filter, three envelopes, an LFO, an arpeggiator, distortion and delay. Rebuilt from FL Studio Mobile's SuperSaw.
c.gen-poizone: Two-oscillator synth engine with unison, filter, LFO, envelopes, arpeggiator, step gate, chorus and tape-style delay.
c.gen-sakura: Physical-model synth of plucked and struck strings, with exciter, two strings, comb, resonators, modulation matrix, delay, chorus and reverb.
c.gen-sawer: Saw-based synth engine with a sub saw, unison, filter, LFO, arpeggiator, modulation slots and chorus, phaser, delay and reverb effects.
c.gen-simsynth: Classic three-oscillator synth engine with ring modulation, amplifier and filter envelopes, a resonant filter and an LFO.
c.gen-slicex: Slicer and drum sampler with two sample decks. The regions of each deck play from their own keys, with layering, articulator envelopes and LFOs, and a filter per articulator group.
c.gen-snare: Built-in snare drum: a short sine tone with high-passed noise and a 0.22 second decay. It has no editor window.
c.gen-synth: LYNX SHARE's own three-oscillator subtractive synth with a filter, envelopes, a tone control and a modulation page. It is the default instrument of a new project.
c.gen-sytrus: Six-operator FM and ring-modulation synth with a modulation matrix, three filters and unison. It plays imported FL Studio Sytrus channels and presets.
c.gen-toxic-biohazard: Six-operator FM and wavetable synth with a filter, two LFOs, two effect slots and an eight-band equaliser. It plays imported FL Studio Toxic Biohazard channels.
c.gen-transistor-bass: Monophonic bass synth with a step sequencer, distortion, delay and reverb. It plays imported FL Studio Transistor Bass channels and programs.
c.gen-vfx-color-mapper: A Patcher note processor that sends each note to a voice output and changes its note colour, depending on the colour it arrives with.
c.gen-vfx-envelope: A Patcher note processor that shapes a note's velocity, pitch, pan and modulation values over time with an envelope and an LFO per target.
c.gen-vfx-key-mapper: A Patcher note processor that remaps each key of an octave to other notes, with a choice of how several outputs play.
c.gen-vfx-keyboard-splitter: A Patcher note processor that splits the keyboard and velocity range into 16 zones, each sending its notes to its own output.
c.gen-vfx-level-scaler: A Patcher note processor that reshapes velocity, release, fine pitch, pan or modulation values of notes with a transfer curve and optional randomness.
c.gen-vfx-script: A Patcher note processor driven by a Python script that can change, create and delay notes. Runs with LYNX SHARE's built-in Python.
c.gen-vfx-sequencer: A Patcher note processor that turns held notes into arpeggios and step sequences, using a bank of 128 programs with six lanes of 64 steps.
c.gen-voltage-controller: Turns notes into control voltages and clock pulses for modular gear, through a DC-coupled audio interface. It makes no audible sound itself.
c.gen-wave-traveller: Plays a loaded sample by moving a read position along a drawn curve, with a second curve for volume. It plays imported FL Studio Wave Traveller channels.
